hyperedges.description: Invite lifecycle: master generates hash via RedisInviteService (TTL 8h, reverse index), URL built from configurable INVITE_BASE_URL, player joins via GET /rooms/join/{hash}

hyperedges.label: Redis TTL-Backed State (sessions, rate limits, invites)

nodes.label: Login and JWT Authentication Flow
nodes.rationale: POST /login validates credentials with BCrypt, generates a JWT via JwtService, persists a Redis session, and returns the token in the Authorization response header; stateless design (no server-side HTTP sessions, CSRF disabled).

nodes.label: JwtService (Token Generation and Validation)
nodes.rationale: HMAC-signed tokens with sub=email, iat, exp; 8h expiration (28800000 ms) configured via jwt.secret/jwt.expiration in application.yaml. Operations: generateToken, extractEmail, isTokenValid, getIssuedAt, getExpiration.

nodes.label: RedisSessionService (Redis Session Storage)
nodes.rationale: Sessions stored as Redis hash auth:{email} with token, createdAt, expiresAt; TTL set to token remaining lifetime so sessions self-expire with the JWT.

nodes.label: JwtAuthenticationFilter
nodes.rationale: OncePerRequestFilter that extracts the Bearer token, validates it via JwtService.isTokenValid, extracts the email via JwtService.extractEmail, and sets the SecurityContextHolder authentication.

nodes.label: RateLimitFilter (Redis IP Rate Limiting)
nodes.rationale: Protects POST /login and POST /register against abuse: 5 requests per 1-minute window per IP using atomic Redis increments on rate_limit:{route}:{ip} keys with TTL; supports X-Forwarded-For; runs first in the filter chain to block excess traffic before any processing; returns 429.

nodes.label: SecurityConfig (Spring Security Configuration)
nodes.rationale: CSRF disabled because the API is stateless with JWT auth; STATELESS session policy; public routes /register, /login and Swagger paths; filter chain order RateLimitFilter -> JwtAuthenticationFilter -> UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter.

nodes.label: InvalidCredentialsException (401 BUSINESS_ERROR)
nodes.rationale: Thrown both when email is not found and when the password does not match, so attackers cannot distinguish which credential failed.

nodes.label: User Registration Flow
nodes.rationale: POST /register: checks email uniqueness (EmailAlreadyExistsException), name uniqueness (NameAlreadyExistsException), encrypts password with BCrypt, maps DTO to entity via RegisterMapper, persists via UserRepository. Plaintext password is never stored.

nodes.label: @ValidPassword Custom Validator
nodes.rationale: Regex-based strength rules: min 8 chars, lowercase, uppercase, special char. A numeric digit is deliberately not required; min length plus other rules is considered sufficient for strong passwords.

nodes.label: @PasswordMatch Class-Level Validator
nodes.rationale: Class-level annotation comparing senha and confirmacaoSenha fields via BeanWrapperImpl; mismatch produces a class-level validation error keyed by the DTO object name rather than a field name.

nodes.label: BCrypt Password Encryption
nodes.rationale: BCryptPasswordEncoder provided as a Spring bean in SecurityConfig; encoding happens in RegisterService before persisting, and RegisterMapper receives the already-encoded password.

nodes.label: GlobalExceptionHandler
nodes.rationale: Central handler mapping MethodArgumentNotValidException to 400 VALIDATION_ERROR, business exceptions to BUSINESS_ERROR, and a fallback Exception handler to 500 INTERNAL_ERROR, all wrapped in ResponseDTO.

nodes.label: DotenvConfig (.env Loading)
nodes.rationale: Custom ApplicationContextInitializer using dotenv-java that injects .env entries as a Spring property source with maximum priority, so DB/Redis/JWT variables resolve in application.yaml placeholders.

nodes.label: Flyway Schema Migrations Policy
nodes.rationale: All schema changes go through Flyway migrations in src/main/resources/db/migration with baseline-on-migrate: true; never rely on ddl-auto for production schema changes.

nodes.label: Redis Infrastructure Usage
nodes.rationale: Redis serves rate limiting (per-IP TTL counters via RateLimitFilter) and Spring Cache (spring.cache.type=redis); configured through REDIS_HOST/REDIS_PORT/REDIS_DATABASE env vars.

nodes.label: Test Environment Configuration (H2, Flyway Disabled)
nodes.rationale: Tests use an in-memory H2 database and disable Flyway so PostgreSQL and Redis are not required to run the suite; H2 is testRuntimeOnly in build.gradle.

nodes.label: Planned Observability (Prometheus, Grafana, OTEL)
nodes.rationale: Placeholders exist for Prometheus metrics, Grafana dashboards, and OpenTelemetry distributed tracing; not yet configured.

nodes.label: Docker Compose Infrastructure (PostgreSQL + Redis with healthchecks and persistent volumes)
nodes.norm_label: docker compose infrastructure (postgresql + redis with healthchecks and persistent volumes)

nodes.label: postgres service (postgres:15-alpine, env-driven DB_NAME/DB_USERNAME/DB_PASSWORD, pg_isready healthcheck, postgres_data volume)
nodes.norm_label: postgres service (postgres:15-alpine, env-driven db_name/db_username/db_password, pg_isready healthcheck, postgres_data volume)

nodes.label: redis service (redis:7-alpine, AOF appendonly enabled, redis-cli ping healthcheck, redis_data volume)
nodes.norm_label: redis service (redis:7-alpine, aof appendonly enabled, redis-cli ping healthcheck, redis_data volume)

nodes.label: Configurable INVITE_BASE_URL env var
nodes.rationale: Invite link base URL is loaded from the INVITE_BASE_URL .env variable instead of being hardcoded, allowing per-environment configuration (default https://api.rpg.com/rooms/join/)

nodes.label: Player Count Derivation via COUNT(room_players)
nodes.rationale: current_players is recalculated from COUNT(room_players) after each join because the room_players table is the source of truth, avoiding drift from a manually incremented counter
